rdf:Description.dc:title: Article 24 table 8
rdf:Description.dc:description: Threat or condition | Affected decision | Property to preserve | Required evidence | Evaluation measure | Intended response; Use beyond delegated scope | Model, data, and tool selection | Task-bounded authority | Identity, delegation, and authorization decision | Accepted decisions outside scope | Block or interrupt unauthorized reach; Fallback to a prohibited destination | Deployment or provider substitution | Constraint continuity | Initial and actual destination, applicable rule, and change reason | Policy-incompatible substitutions | Use an admissible alternative or suspend; Data exposure | Inference, embedding, and telemetry selection | Minimization and authorized processing | Data class, destinations, and retention conditions | Unauthorized transfers and excess data | Prevent egress and address exposure; Adversarial cost escalation | Model, effort, and retries | Task and organization limits | Accumulated consumption and escalation decisions | Spending before containment and false rejections | Contain trajectory and review policy; Revoked state or permission | Cache, queues, or prior decisions | Current authorization | Policy version and revocation and execution times | Post-revocation actions and propagation delay | Invalidate reuse and interrupt affected actions; Evaluator failure | Accept, escalate, or authorize action | Acceptance suitable for the effect | Rubric, result, and subsequent verification | False acceptances, false rejections, and disagreements | Reassess and limit authorized effects; Prohibited collective effect | Subtask distribution | Shared-trajectory boundaries | Relationships among agents, actions, and resources | Violations per task and containment time | Contain affected participants and reconcile state; Gateway compromise | Selection, access, and recording | Privilege separation and recovery | Versions, changes, and protected records | Compromise reach and revocation time | Isolate components and recover credentials and policies; Lost or altered evidence | Investigation and continued operation | Verifiability of critical decisions | Trail integrity, provenance, and completeness | Critical events lacking sufficient evidence | Reduce permitted operation and reconstruct the incident
